text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh~. So Curren got a stuffed animal from 
her dad.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah♪ They came all the way here to wish 
me a happy birthday in person.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And also, there was a giant bouquet of 
roses~, and even a letter for Curren 
inside!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Could it be~... you want a letter 
from your papa too, Swoopy?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I-I don't need any more of those! They 
send so many it's annoying! ...Though none 
arrived this week, but still."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, Curren has never thought it's 
annoying, you know? I mean... wouldn't you 
be happy if someone wrote 100 pages worth 
of love letters for you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everything I love about Curren, how cute 
she is... and a big "thank you for being 
born"♪ It's a letter packed with sooo much 
love!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Hmph! If I asked him, my dad would 
write 200 copies for me in a heartbeat!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, I'll have them bring it 
over by the end of the day!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu♪ The day Curren was born has to 
be full of love from everyone♪"
